purpose: Exploratory fixed-basket daily US equity baseline; no population-wide alpha claim
selection_rule: Twenty-four named surviving companies, four in each of six research groups, chosen for a transparent long-history demonstration before inspecting strategy returns. Not point-in-time constituents.
execution: Observe close t; trade at close t+1; first new-position P&L at close t+2. Reset capital and liquidate at each phase boundary.
calendar: Require every asset to match the observed SPY session dates exactly; do not silently intersect or forward-fill
missing_data: Reject the dataset; investigate and revise protocol explicitly if needed
liquidity_rule: Require positive reported volume on every session. Report a 20-session dollar-volume proxy; no claim of executable capacity or historical borrow availability.
corporate_actions: Use provider-adjusted closes; retain provider split and dividend events. No independent full corporate-action reconciliation; no separate dividend addition.
parameter_search: None in Milestone 2. All cost scenarios reported. No return-driven stock or date replacement.
holdout_policy: Do not acquire or evaluate final-holdout bars during Milestone 2. A later protocol revision will explicitly release the final test.
limitations: Current-vintage adjusted data, not a point-in-time database
Illustrative linear costs and uniform borrow
No cash interest, financing rebates or market impact
